# universal-actuator-mcp — full reference

Industrial Federation Gateway. FastMCP 3.4+, Python 3.12+, dual transport (stdio + SSE on port 10745). Routes actions to 15+ sub-servers via config.json.

## Tools

### universal_actuator(domain, action, ...)
Portmanteau: routes actions to sub-servers. Domains: media (search/recommend), system (info/process), files (list/search).

### universal_status()
Hub health: registered domains, federation graph connectivity, RAG stats, log count.

### search_federated(query, sources)
Parallel fan-out search across calibre, plex, immich, docsops, knowledge nodes.

### rag_semantic_search(query)
Vector similarity search over ingested fleet content via LanceDB (384-dim, all-MiniLM-L6-v2).

### ingest_fleet_to_rag(source)
Bulk ingest: calibre metadata, plex media, immich assets, docs into LanceDB.

### rag_stats() / rag_clear()
RAG engine statistics and full reset.

### glom_on(domain)
Runtime auto-discovery and attachment of a new sub-server.

### get_fleet_telemetry()
Live telemetry — CPU, memory, uptime, response times from all sub-servers.

### universal_milestone(title, description)
Record a milestone via Advanced Memory MCP cognitive bridge.

### get_milestones_history()
Retrieve milestone timeline.

### list_ollama_models()
Query local Ollama for available models.

### agentic_workflow_tool(goal)
SEP-1577: Plan → Execute → Audit via ctx.sample().

### universal_shutdown()
Graceful server termination.

## REST Endpoints

- GET /api/v1/health — liveness
- GET /api/v1/deps — dependency versions
- GET /api/v1/models — Ollama models
- GET /telemetry — live telemetry
- GET/POST /api/logs — ring-buffer log queries
- POST /chat — chat interface
- POST /api/shutdown — terminate server
- GET/POST /library, /library/ingest — media library

## Ports

- Backend: 10745 (SSE + REST)
- Webapp: 10982 (Vite dev)
